headline: CSM drag to persist over the next 2–3 quarters

The CSM segment continued to face headwinds, with exports declining 18% YoY, driven by a 3–4% decline in volumes and a 13–14% impact from pricing and cost pressures, amid genericisation of key molecules and weak global agrochemical demand.
Management expects these headwinds to persist over the next 2–3 quarters, with some recovery in volumes towards the end of FY27.
The domestic Agri business grew 19% YoY, supported by differentiated products and 45% growth in biologicals.
